requires: Native linguistic review before any production-quality claim.
note: Every record below is an AI engineering draft. NO human has reviewed this file. reviewStatus must only be changed by a person, through the review workflow in docs/spell/MORPHOLOGY_POLICY.md.

defaults.provenance: Expanded from a hand-written textbook suffix chart (not from UniMorph, not from the analyzer's tables), then reviewed form by form by the author. Independent external corroboration is limited: see scripts/spell-gold-crosscheck.ts.

expectedKinds.VALID: valid inflected form: the engine must return VALID
expectedKinds.INVALID: definitely invalid: the engine must NOT return VALID (MISSPELLED or UNKNOWN)
expectedKinds.VALID_UNSUPPORTED: valid Mongolian that M1 deliberately does not recognise without a lexicon flag: the engine must return UNKNOWN
expectedKinds.DERIVATION: derived stem (M2): the engine must return UNKNOWN: never VALID, never MISSPELLED
expectedKinds.AMBIGUOUS: contested or oracle-only: the engine must not return MISSPELLED
